solutions.title: Pair scan
solutions.strategy: For each sentence position, scan the similarity list for a direct pair match.

timeComplexity.explanation: n word positions may scan m pairs.

spaceComplexity.explanation: No extra data structure is required.

solutions.title: Undirected pair set
solutions.strategy: Store both directions of every pair in a set and check each word position in O(1).

timeComplexity.explanation: Build the pair set once and scan both sentences once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The set stores two directed keys per pair.
